messages:
mia sanchez: Quick ask — can someone run onboarding bench + profiling for macaw-12b-v1 on 8xA100? Need latency percentiles, peak GPU memory, and KV-cache perf. Targets: p95 <= 220ms for 1k-token streams, peak < 7GB/GPU. Use q4f quant by default. Can we get a smoke run today? @jorge li @evan cho
jorge li: I can kick this off this afternoon. Which prompt set and what steady-state concurrency?
mia sanchez: Use onboard_promptset_v2 (mix of short prompts + ~1k continuation cases). For steady-state please do a 60s run with 32 warmers then 500 concurrent clients (so we can see batching behavior).
ev an cho: I'll take profiling (kernel timelines + nvprof). Can you paste the exact bench command + batch sweep you want? Also confirm continuous batching on/off.
mia sanchez: continuous batching ON. Sweep batch sizes 1,4,8. Please collect per-token throughput and p50/p95/p99. Also capture one flamegraph and the raw perf trace.
evan cho: ack. Command I'll use:```bash
./run_bench --model macaw-12b-v1 --gpus 8 --promptset onboard_promptset_v2 --seq 1024 --batch-sizes 1,4,8 --quant q4f --continuous-batching on --duration 60 --clients 500 --out ./macaw12b_results.json
```
benchbot: queued job bb-12893 (macaw-12b-v1, 8xA100, q4f). ETA to start ~10m.
benchbot: job bb-12893 started on pool-gpu-7 at 1749254400. Logs: https://internal.redwood/bench/bb-12893/logs
evan cho: early smoke posted: p50 95ms, p95 210ms, p99 370ms for 1k seq; peak mem per GPU 6.4GB; steady throughput ~420 tok/s/GPU at batch=8. KV-cache lookup latency looks normal.
rachel taylor: nice, p95 is within our target. Any tail regressions vs. the baseline (quasar7b baseline we used for comparison)?
evan cho: compared to quasar7b baseline on same infra: p50 down ~5%, p95 comparable, p99 +8% on long tails. Profiling shows attention_kv refill stalls on sequences where cache miss threshold triggers extra memcpy. Will dig into reuse logic.
mia sanchez: thanks. Can you upload the flamegraph and raw trace? Drop link here.
evan cho: uploaded: https://internal.redwood/results/macaw12b/1749254321/flamegraph.svg and full trace: https://internal.redwood/results/macaw12b/1749254321/trace.tar.gz
jorge li: noted. Action items: 1) Evan to file a follow-up perf ticket with traces + kernel slices (I can pick this up if blocked). 2) Mia to review accuracy/regression evals on the same promptset. 3) If OK, schedule canary on Dedicated for next week.
evan cho: filing ticket now: PERF-4821 (macaw12b attention-kv-stall) and attaching traces.
sre-bot: reminder: any canary deploy to Dedicated requires a capacity hold request 48h in advance. Please open a dedicated-capacity ticket if you want next-week canary.
mia sanchez: will open the capacity ticket today. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
rachel taylor: great job. Optional: Jorge, when you run a deeper sweep can you try batch=16 briefly to see if throughput improves or memory spikes?
jorge li: will do a quick batch=16 check tomorrow morning and post results here.
ev an cho: final note — enabling xformers new attention kernel reduced p99 by ~20% in local infra; we'll test with that patch in a follow-up run.
mia sanchez: excellent. closing loop for now, will summarize in the onboarding doc and link bench artifacts.
